critic.name: /root/critic
critic.method: Opened all 74 original PNGs in 37 stock/Aven pairs and the additional Aven paused-media poster at original resolution. Also independently reviewed 40 stock and 46 Aven distinct native motion states in chronological order. No source changes, screenshot edits or guest UI input. Native operation outcomes are attributed to their recorded witnesses; the critic did not rerun those inputs.

pairs.content_id: Clean desktop with native panel

inspection.notes: Stock has high-contrast blue relief and a nearly full-width dark panel. Aven has broad low-contrast jade curves and a shorter light panel, immediately quieter and visibly distinct. Native app identities remain recognizable. A still does not prove motion.

pairs.content_id: Same nine Home entries with Documents selected; product-default list/grid presentation

inspection.notes: Both show the same nine Home entries with Documents selected. Aven uses a details list while stock uses a grid: this is a product-default comparison, not font-only. Wider Places labels are fully readable, common folders are focused, and jade folders and soft decoration are calmer. The unnamed red capacity bar and extra internal volume are absent. The remaining fedora_aven-lab volume is readable but technical. The current Home breadcrumb remains heavy.

pairs.content_id: Dolphin 12-file Everyday folder in details view

inspection.notes: The same twelve files are visible. Aven uses larger readable Chinese/Latin labels, approximately 36-pixel compact rows, smaller thumbnails and no tree-branch clutter; stock has approximately 52-pixel thumbnail rows. Dates and KiB remain aligned. Selection differs: Aven highlights the Chinese text file, while stock has an Earthrise focus outline. The current 日常 · Everyday breadcrumb is conspicuously bold.

pairs.content_id: Dolphin 12-file Everyday folder in grid view

inspection.notes: Both show the twelve-file Everyday folder with an Earthrise focus outline. Aven uses four columns over three rows with much larger image, document and media thumbnails; stock has nine small items in the first row. Long mixed-script names mostly fit on one line in Aven. The subdued sidebar and chrome improve hierarchy. Generic audio/JSON icons retain strong native blue/purple colors.

pairs.content_id: NASA Earthrise JPEG selected in Dolphin

inspection.notes: Stock confines Earthrise to an approximately 160-pixel-wide information-panel thumbnail amid metadata and reflows Files. Aven gives the full image an approximately 832-pixel-wide focused overlay with a quiet localized title, JPEG 图像 / 84.1 KiB footer and clearly spaced Open control. The preview task icon reveals a separate native surface. Invocation and focus results are documented separately.

pairs.content_id: Original bilingual weekend-walk PDF selected in Dolphin

inspection.notes: The same bilingual weekend-walk PDF is a tiny whole-page thumbnail in stock. Aven fits the page to a readable width with scrolling, a pale paper backing and consistent PDF 文档 / 260.6 KiB footer. Chinese paragraphs and mixed Latin headings are readable. The embedded PDF fonts are not evidence of OS fallback improvement; the lower page requires normal scrolling.

pairs.content_id: Simplified Chinese and Latin text fixture selected in Dolphin

inspection.notes: Stock shows a generic text icon and metadata rather than readable content. Aven exposes real SC paragraphs, mixed Latin, MB, times, paths, punctuation, dense characters and emoji. The approximately 18-pixel body, comfortable leading and inset are coherent. No missing-glyph boxes or clipped sample glyphs appear; the final emoji row is visible. Emoji styles retain their font-native differences.

pairs.content_id: Flower WebM selected in Dolphin

inspection.notes: Stock has a small film-framed poster and metadata-dock player. Aven shows a large genuine playing flower frame, a pause control, seek line and 0:00 / 0:05 duration. Playback moments differ, so the exact flower pixels are not a matched still-frame comparison. The separately inspected paused poster also reports 0:00 / 0:05, resolving the prior zero-total label. Audio and full playback continuity are not established by this still.

pairs.content_id: Local Simplified Chinese City Notes article in Firefox

inspection.notes: The same SC City Notes HTTP article is readable in both; body typography and authored page spacing remain very similar. Aven neutral tabs/toolbar match its shared decoration, and larger native chrome text is more comfortable. The extra titlebar repeats the title and costs about 38 logical pixels. Stock has a page-brand keyboard outline while Aven does not; that state difference is not a typography gain. A single Firefox task identity is visible.

pairs.content_id: Local Traditional Chinese City Notes article in Firefox

inspection.notes: The same TC City Notes article retains clear corner quotes, punctuation and mixed English/numbers. Body rendering already looks strong in stock and is nearly unchanged. Aven neutral chrome is more coherent with the surrounding desktop, with larger chrome labels and a single task identity. The additional server-side titlebar reduces content height. Fixture-authored reading rhythm is not credited as an OS change.

pairs.content_id: Live Chinese Firefox website in native Firefox

inspection.notes: Both show the actual Chinese Firefox website with its large purple hero. Aven quiet neutral chrome frames the branded site coherently while leaving its page design intact. Stock has two tabs and Aven one; URL query/context differs slightly, while the principal content is matched. Chinese web text remains readable. This is a real web-page frame, not a broad compatibility test.

pairs.content_id: Four fictional offline messages in Thunderbird inbox

inspection.notes: The same four fictional messages appear. Aven warm neutral surfaces, larger text and jade compose control fit the desktop better. The approximately 330-pixel message cards are narrower than stock's approximately 430 pixels, truncating sender addresses in three rows. Subjects remain readable. A titlebar plus mostly empty top strip consumes more height than stock. The single Thunderbird task identity is coherent, but list efficiency is still a weak point.

pairs.content_id: Same fictional Simplified Chinese email opened in Thunderbird

inspection.notes: The same fictional SC message is comfortably inset and spaced in Aven, with approximately 17-pixel body text and 30-pixel leading versus stock's tighter 24-pixel rhythm and near-edge body. Latin address text and Chinese punctuation remain clear; paragraph breaks are preserved. The narrow adjacent message list and extra top strip remain. Window/client layout differences are acknowledged.

pairs.content_id: Same fictional Traditional Chinese email opened in Thunderbird

inspection.notes: The same fictional TC message has a calm, readable body with generous inset and leading, preserving punctuation, v2.1 and 11:00. Stock is readable but tighter and close to the content edge. Native header controls and bold labels remain somewhat dense. The message-card truncation and mostly empty upper strip still limit coherence. This is a 1x primary mail comparison.

pairs.content_id: Same fictional saved reply with appended route-confirmation sentence

inspection.notes: Both show the same fictional saved draft, including 已核对路线，周六见。 before round-04 editing. Aven now gives wrapped/body and signature lines approximately 30-pixel leading, visibly more comfortable than stock's approximately 24 pixels, with a useful inset. This resolves the round-03 writing-versus-reading rhythm defect. The 1000×840 outer frame is matched. The existing blank paragraph before the appended sentence belongs to the draft. The matched 720-pixel supplemental pair confirms the improvement under wrapping.

pairs.content_id: Eight-photo Kyoto travel album in Gwenview browse view

inspection.notes: The same eight Kyoto album images appear. Aven's approximately 240-pixel thumbnails form five-plus-three rows and make the album immediately useful; stock places eight tiny thumbnails in one row. Aven selects the river image while stock selects the first image, and Aven has a small native hover affordance. The heavy breadcrumb surround and native thumbnail frames remain more mechanical than Files.

pairs.content_id: Kyoto mountain-river landscape in Gwenview fitted view

inspection.notes: Both show the same Kyoto mountain-river image upright. Aven fits it at 79% with a short filmstrip; stock fits at 92% with no filmstrip. Navigation context is useful but costs photo area. The filmstrip's beveled/gradient cells and horizontal bar retain an older native KDE appearance. This is a reasonable mature-viewer tradeoff, not a premium new photo surface.

pairs.content_id: Same labeled EXIF-6 waterfall orientation fixture

inspection.notes: Both correctly display the same EXIF-6 fixture upright, with the original TOP/LEFT/RIGHT/BOTTOM labels in the correct orientation. Aven fits at 56% versus stock 65% because of its filmstrip. This verifies this orientation sample visually, not every EXIF orientation or color-management case.

pairs.content_id: Same unmodified 32×32 alpha PNG at native 100% image zoom

inspection.notes: Both show the unmodified 32×32 transparent PNG at native 100%, so it is intentionally small. Aven checkerboard makes transparency distinguishable; stock's transparent side blends into its white canvas. The matched 800% supplemental pair makes this distinction much clearer. This is not evidence of changed asset pixels or display color accuracy.

pairs.content_id: Same unchanged fictional SC draft in matched 720×840 outer frame at 600,140

inspection.notes: Opened both original 1920×1200 frames. In the matched narrow composer, the existing Chinese paragraph wraps naturally. Aven successive wrapped lines and signature lines have approximately 30-pixel leading versus stock's approximately 24 pixels. Mixed Latin and Chinese remain clear, and Aven's inset prevents body text hugging the edge. Identical draft content was captured before the round-04 save test; the pre-existing blank paragraph remains. This is the concrete visible correction supporting the small Chinese/mail score increase.

pairs.content_id: Same unmodified 32×32 transparent PNG shown at 800% image zoom

inspection.notes: Opened both original frames. At 800%, the same 256-pixel-square displayed asset clearly shows its alpha gradient: stock fades into the white canvas, while Aven exposes a checkerboard behind the transparent area. The checker is a useful viewer presentation default rather than image corruption. The filmstrip remains visibly beveled. No calibrated-color claim follows.

At 100%, the native-pixel text remains comfortable and legible in the inspected VM.

chinese_typography.rationale: The four-scale current SC/TC native and prose matrix is clean. Larger ordinary UI text, full readable Places labels, the comfortable preview body, and now-consistent mail reading/writing rhythm form a product-grade Chinese experience. The matched narrow composer concretely resolves the prior crowded 24-pixel leading. This is a small justified increase from round 03, not a claim of transformed font rasterization.
limitations: Stock already has correct Noto SC/TC fallback and clean controlled browser prose; there is no demonstrated dramatic prose-rasterization advantage.
Native current breadcrumbs remain too dark. Mail and preview body comparisons are at 1x; the four-scale matrix covers Dolphin and Firefox.
No direct macOS screenshots, physical-panel reading study or arbitrary-content coverage.

latin_typography.rationale: Larger native UI labels, clear filenames/extensions, calm preview text and comfortable mail leading make Latin text a coherent partner to Chinese. Browser chrome, titles and addresses have legible hierarchy.
limitations: Current breadcrumbs are heavy; Thunderbird cards truncate addresses because of width.
Page-authored typography is not credited as a system rendering change.

files_experience.rationale: The wider focused sidebar, much more useful mixed-file grid, readable compact details view and subdued folder/selection treatment substantially improve the primary surface. The verification agent records successful native navigation, selection and reversible file operations with byte checks.
limitations: Active breadcrumbs and the remaining technical volume label retain KDE character.
Primary Home defaults differ in view mode; matrix row density is a separate controlled state.
Critic inspected visual evidence; operation inputs were performed by the named verification witnesses.

file_preview.rationale: Images, PDFs, real Chinese text and media are now useful at a glance in a coherent focused overlay. The corrected paused duration removes a misleading zero-total detail. Independently inspected native transition states show a stable underlying Files list and retained selection, and verification confirms repeat-toggle and Escape focus return.
limitations: Ctrl+Alt+P is functional but less discoverable than a dedicated obvious preview affordance.
A separate preview task icon briefly appears. PDF fonts are embedded; audio and full continuous video playback were not independently established.

browser_coherence.rationale: Firefox has compatible neutral tabs, toolbar and shared decoration with larger readable chrome text and one task identity. Both Chinese fixture articles and the live Chinese Firefox page remain intact. Native download/reveal and portal selection are verified separately.
limitations: The extra titlebar repeats page title and consumes height.
Actual site bodies were already good in stock; no broad web-compatibility or complete TC UI-localization claim.

mail_coherence.rationale: Warm surfaces and restrained jade emphasis fit Aven. Real SC/TC reading is comfortable, and the corrected editable-body leading makes writing equally calm at both matched window widths. A native offline edit/save/close/reopen round trip succeeded according to verification.
limitations: The narrow message-card column truncates sender addresses; the mostly empty top strip wastes space.
Native header and formatting controls remain denser than Files.
No account setup, live receive or sending was tested.

photo_experience.rationale: The large eight-image album is substantially more useful than stock's tiny single row. The short filmstrip gives context while keeping the viewed photo prominent. Inspected EXIF-6 orientation and transparent-image presentation are correct; native next/previous and fullscreen were verified.
limitations: Breadcrumb surround and beveled filmstrip still look distinctly native KDE.
The filmstrip reduces fitted-photo area versus stock, and only one labeled EXIF orientation was sampled.
No calibrated color-management or broad image-format claim.

visual_coherence.rationale: The jade/neutral desktop, quiet surfaces, shared decoration, consistent UI scale and focused Files/preview establish a recognizable Aven product. Browser and mail now sit within the same palette without altering their content.
limitations: Thunderbird's upper strip and Gwenview's framing are still visibly less resolved; native application icons retain distinct colors.
This judgment covers the four focused experiences, not the rest of KDE.

perceived_polish.rationale: The strongest surfaces are Files and preview. The final compose rhythm and accurate paused-media duration remove concrete small defects. Inspected sampled transitions are restrained, with calmer fixed-bound window fades and no observed blocking transition defect.
limitations: Sparse VM motion frames support transition character, not 60 Hz smoothness, exact input latency or frame pacing.
Mail/card density and Gwenview framing prevent a premium-consumer-OS score.

three_second.rationale: Yes. The broad pale/jade background and short light panel change the desktop silhouette immediately. The shared quiet chrome, readable sidebar and much larger content/preview hierarchy make the difference more refined as well as conspicuous. This is an independent visual first-impression judgment, not a blinded user study.
